column1: # Headers the spec tables name (spec/abi visibility.tsv, typedefs.tsv, callsites.tsv, noexcept.tsv: the
# `header` column) that libniji does not ship yet. Read by validation/headers_p4.py (P4 of plan/headers.md,
# slice 20): the list must equal the named headers with no file under libniji's staged tree, so a header that
# ships fails P4 until its row is removed here (the list only shrinks), and a header missing without a row
# fails too. A C++ header that fails only because one of these is not found counts as "known", not FAIL, and
# P4 compares callsites.tsv and noexcept.tsv without their rows. Known limitation of the slice 20 switch
# (docs/release-notes.d/SL-HEADERS-S20-2.md); `NIJI_SYSTEM_HEADERS=1` compiles a package that needs one of
# them with the system's headers (coexist flavour). No spec clause: header tooling (plan/headers.md P4).
# Columns, tab-separated: header, what it waits for.
